timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hi shooters, now we're going to talk about correct shooting technique.
The first thing, whether it's the feet or the shoulders, you absolutely need to be lined up with the objective.
Then, I advise you to have your legs a little bent, to give you a touch more flexibility, especially for the moment when you're going to release the boot.
Lastly, it's the swing that's going to make the difference. It'll be a lot wider compared to pointing.
So, what I advise you is to take aim for a second at the start. Do a slow swing down to be more accurate.
And then to swing back up more strongly to get more power.
And it's your ability to reproduce the right technique that will improve your regularity.
Come on, let's have another round.

youtube_description:
The world champion of pétanque Sylvain Dubreuil, reviews the fundamentals of his sport, and explains them to you. 
No secrets here, but to watch the basics shown by a champion is always of interest.
